info.title: Hive Wallet MetaMask Snap API
info.description: API for interacting with the Hive blockchain through MetaMask

methods.name: hive_getPublicKeys
methods.description: Retrieves Hive public keys derived from the MetaMask wallet for specified roles and account indices.

params.name: keys
params.description: Array of key specifications defining which keys to retrieve

accountIndex.description: HD wallet account index (defaults to 0 if not specified)

role.description: Hive key role (posting, active, owner, memo)

result.name: getPublicKeysResult
result.description: Object containing the derived public keys

accountIndex.description: The HD wallet account index used

methods.name: hive_signTransaction
methods.description: Signs a Hive transaction using keys derived from the MetaMask wallet.

params.name: keys
params.description: Array of key specifications to use for signing

accountIndex.description: HD wallet account index (defaults to 0 if not specified)

role.description: Hive key role (posting, active, owner, memo)

methods.name: hive_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a buffer using Hive keys derived from the MetaMask wallet.

params.name: firstKey
params.description: Key specification for the first encryption key

accountIndex.description: HD wallet account index (defaults to 0 if not specified)

role.description: Hive key role (posting, active, owner, memo)

params.name: secondKey
params.description: Second key for encryption (either KeyIndex object or a public key string)

methods.name: hive_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a buffer using a Hive key derived from the MetaMask wallet.

accountIndex.description: HD wallet account index (defaults to 0 if not specified)

role.description: Hive key role (posting, active, owner, memo)

methods.name: hive_aiStoreKey
methods.description: Prototype, not published. Stores an AI provider API key inside the snap after the user confirms a dialog naming the requesting origin and the provider. The key is bound to the origin that stored it and replaces that origin's previous key for the provider; any call allowance for the provider is revoked.

params.name: apiKey
params.description: The provider API key: 1 to 1024 printable ASCII characters without spaces

params.name: label
params.description: Optional label of 1 to 64 characters, returned by hive_aiListKeys

result.name: aiStoreKeyResult
result.description: The stored key's provider and label. Never the key.

methods.name: hive_aiListKeys
methods.description: Prototype, not published. Lists the providers and labels of the keys the requesting origin has stored. Never returns a key.

methods.name: hive_aiForgetKey
methods.description: Prototype, not published. Deletes the requesting origin's key and call allowance for a provider.

methods.name: hive_aiCall
methods.description: Prototype, not published. POSTs a JSON body to an allowlisted provider URL with the key the requesting origin stored, sent only in the provider's auth header (Anthropic: x-api-key; OpenAI and DeepSeek: Authorization Bearer). The user approves each call in a dialog naming the origin, provider and model, and may allow the origin for 15 or 60 minutes. Redirects are refused, the response is capped at 1 MB, and the request times out after 120 seconds. Request/response only: no streaming. Errors: 4100 when the origin has no key for the provider, 4001 when the user rejects, -32000 for an unknown provider, a path that is not allowlisted or a body that is not an object, -32603 for a network failure, timeout, redirect or oversized response.

params.name: path
params.description: Request path, matched exactly against the provider's allowlist: anthropic /v1/messages (https://api.anthropic.com), openai /v1/chat/completions (https://api.openai.com), deepseek /chat/completions (https://api.deepseek.com)

params.name: body
params.description: JSON request body sent to the provider. A string `model` field is shown in the approval dialog.

result.name: aiCallResult
result.description: The provider's response. Any occurrence of the key in the body is replaced with [redacted].

body.description: Response body, parsed as JSON when it is JSON, otherwise the text
